description: USDA Agricultural Baseline Database is published by USDA Economic Research Service. The database publishes ten-year domestic agricultural commodity projections. Its stated coverage is United States; annual projection vintages. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. The provider says international trade projections through 2035 were not produced in 2026. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
